summary: Residential kerb where cars park, homes about 15 m behind.
reasons: Homes 15 m behind on own side

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings 15 m and 23 m on the east side; homes closer (8-12 m) either side of this section.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed road with a parking lane; cars park along it.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked along both kerbs; no signs on this stretch.

flags: Dwellings 8-12 m away along most of the rest of the kerb
sun_shade: Open kerb with some garden trees; afternoon sun from the west over the road.

best_section.where: Meiers Road east kerb, north of the first bend
